definition: Online expressions are recorded and archived; they outlast the moment.
apply_when: Old posts resurface; people refer back to earlier messages; someone can't delete something.
do_not_apply_when: The text only mentions memory or nostalgia, with no recorded content involved (consider other).

definition: Content can be seen by audiences beyond the one intended.
apply_when: Concern about who can see something; public vs. private framing; context collapse between audiences.
do_not_apply_when: The content is simply posted, with no reference to audience.

definition: Content can be easily copied, forwarded, or reposted.
apply_when: Forwarding, reposting, screenshots, cross-posting between platforms or groups.
do_not_apply_when: Content is only viewed, not moved.

definition: Content can be found through search.
apply_when: People search, or fail to search, platform content; search tools shape what is findable.
do_not_apply_when: People look things up offline (menus, notebooks). That is not platform searchability.

definition: Something analytically interesting that the codes above don't capture.
apply_when: A recurring idea, tension, or practice. Give it a short provisional label, e.g. other: nostalgia.
do_not_apply_when: Use only when you can name what it is. Don't use it as a dumping ground.
